q: ‘Nature’ refers to all the _____ that influence physical characteristics.
e: ‘Nature’ refers to all the genes and hereditary factors that influence physical characteristics. Accidents and scars is not genes and hereditary factors.

q: ‘Nurture’ refers to all the _____ that impact on character.
e: ‘Nurture’ refers to all the environmental variables that impact on character. Genes inherited from parents is not environmental variables.

q: An apple tree seed will never grow into an oak tree because of _____
e: An apple tree seed will never grow into an oak tree because of genetic variation. Meiosis, crossing over, and random fertilisation generate genetic variation. Seed plants are gymnosperms and angiosperms. Artificial selection is not genetic variation.

q: A scar from an accident is an example of _____ variation.
e: A scar from an accident is an example of environmental variation. Genetic is not environmental.

q: Genetically identical plants grown under different light conditions look different due to _____
e: Genetically identical plants grown under different light conditions look different due to environmental variation. Mitosis makes genetically identical body cells for growth and repair. Meiosis is different: meiosis is reduction division that makes haploid gametes and shuffles alleles.
